scope: Private CPU packed-world retention candidate, source and existing test-log review only. No adoption or new execution.
findings: Packed layer and slot regions use Arc copy-on-write. Metadata replacement copies tables and fonts but shares unchanged records with pinned worlds; writes detach only the affected region.

Retention requires matching atlas base, source predecessor/current sequence, compatible grid and record format, no full world invalidation and no untracked prefix record replacement. Leaving a prefix that may have omitted records forces full rebuild.
Table changes force full GPU world replacement and free-sprite refresh; ordinary cell/slot changes use existing delta paths. No shader, pixel renderer, lock or synchronization change.

Regression fixtures exercise real Mapping rollback, restored source with newer prepared world, re-adoption of consumed changes, same-sequence art growth, aliases, slots and prefix entry/restoration/exit. Corrected9b source-delta recovery remains in place.
Thirty CPU tests are verified by existing hash-bound logs. No material source issue found in reviewed paths.
